programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 4
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 21
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Setelah putus dengan pacarnya, seorang wiraniaga Bao bertemu dengan seorang gadis kaya, Jin Jin, yang juga baru putus dengan kekasihnya. Dua orang asing yang patah hati ini pun langsung jatuh cinta dan menikah.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Film kung fu ini menampilkan aksi dua penipu yang tengah mencari emas tersembunyi bersama beberapa biksu Shaolin, seorang penjahat kejam dan sang adik yang bisu namun berbahaya.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: Saat seorang pemuda dan kekasihnya terpisah selamanya akibat ulah sang paman dan temannya, gadis itu pun terdorong untuk bunuh diri. Namun, arwah sang gadis muncul kembali untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Kueh Chih Hung, sang sutradara pujaan, menampilkan kisah tragedi romantis tentang arwah Lo Meng yang berupaya merasuk ke dalam tubuh cinta sejatinya, namun upayanya justru menjadi bumerang.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Setelah sukses menyutradarai film pertamanya, Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung King-tin menyajikan film komedi bertema benturan budaya ketika seorang petani asal Tiongkok Daratan memboyong keluarganya ke Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai Kwei Wu menyaksikan sebuah penculikan bersama dengan istrinya Kan Lien-chu di Red Lotus Temple. Kan meminta Kwei pergi mencari bantuan saat ia berusaha melawan para penculik.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu berperan sebagai Kwei Wu menyaksikan sebuah penculikan bersama dengan istrinya Kan Lien-chu di Red Lotus Temple. Kan meminta Kwei pergi mencari bantuan saat ia berusaha melawan para penculik.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: Seorang hakim korup begitu terobsesi dengan harta karun, ia tak hanya memenjarakan dan menyiksa kekasih putrinya tapi ia juga mengubur putrinya hidup-hidup! Ironisnya, peti mati putrinya yang mengungkap rahasia harta itu.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan dan muridnya Fan bekerja mengangkut zombie. Saat mereka berdua melarikan diri, ternyata salah satu dari mereka sebenarnya adalah seorang pria yang sedang menyamar dan kabur dari musuh-musuhnya.

programme.title: Perils Of Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri merekayasa upaya pembunuhan terhadap seorang pangeran, untuk menyamar di 'Desa Hantu', tempat tersembunyi di mana para penjahat buronan bersembunyi. Sesampainya di sana, ia mulai menyelidiki pemimpin mereka yang penuh rahasia.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan adalah seorang penjudi kambuhan. Ia menjadikan istrinya sebagai uang muka atas utangnya. Ia pun menyesal dan memutuskan untuk bunuh diri, namun niatnya dihentikan oleh kemunculan sesosok hantu cantik.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet berperan sebagai Szu-szu si gadis manja yang mengabaikan cinta sejatinya, Yang Fan, untuk mencari pendekar pedang pujaannya, Chin Ko.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar Pedang Bertangan Satu dipaksa keluar dari masa pensiunnya oleh sebuah organisasi kriminal yang terdiri dari delapan pendekar pedang, yang telah memaksa setiap klan untuk mengirimkan pendekar pedang terbaik mereka untuk bersaing melawan mereka demi supremasi pendekar pedang.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang pasukan tentara yang pergi untuk menghancurkan geng Hsien Lung, yang merupakan kelompok revolusioner anti-Yuan. Pemimpin mereka Ru Yi Tu melawan Fu Zhong Yuan, penerus kelompok Hsien Lung.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: Bendera Besi adalah sebuah klan berbudi pekerti luhur yang harus berhadapan dengan Perhimpunan Rajawali yang menjadi pelindung kegiatan-kegiatan ilegal.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: Seorang asisten profesor mencuri mikrofilm yang menyimpan rahasia reaktor nuklir nan baru ditemukan dan menjualnya ke suatu sindikat kejahatan. Namun, benda itu jatuh ke tangan penari klub malam dan seorang pencuri.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, pemimpin Klan Petinju di Yunnan, membubarkan sebuah klan untuk menyelamatkan murid-muridnya sebelum pergi mengasingkan diri.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Dalam Pale Passion, disutradarai oleh Chin Ping-hsing, Chiang Li-ping berperan sebagai Ah Hsia dalam kisah perselingkuhan, perzinahan dan pengkhianatan yang menyebabkan cinta segitiga berdarah.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: Seorang ahli kung fu dan tiga muridnya kehilangan segalanya usai dikalahkan oleh seorang penindas. Demi membalas dendam, ketiga murid tersebut berlatih pada master kung fu lainnya dan kembali menghadapi si penindas.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Arkeolog Jack terus mengalami mimpi berulang tentang kehidupan masa lalunya, di mana ia adalah Jenderal besar Meng Yi yang bersumpah melindungi seorang putri bernama Ok-Soo. Jack kemudian memutuskan untuk menyelidiki semua misteri tersebut bersama sahabatnya, William.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Seorang detektif Hong Kong mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang melibatkan sebuah medali misterius dan berubah menjadi seorang prajurit abadi dengan kekuatan luar biasa.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: (Subbed) Amad Diallo : PL Stories
programme.desc: From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programme.desc: Tentang kehidupan seorang biduan dangdut keliling bernama Rosa. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. programme.title: Flavor Of Life
programme.desc: Di usia 40 tahun, Han Xiao meninggalkan pekerjaan impiannya dan membuka kembali kedai milik orang tuanya. Kepulangan sang ayah yang mengidap demensia memaksa keluarga menghadapi luka lama dan belajar memulai kembali.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. Melalui peliputan langsung, wawancara, dan analisis yang komprehensif, program ini memberikan perspektif yang lebih luas terhadap berbagai isu global sekaligus menyoroti dampaknya terhadap kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player mengisahkan Pun yang kembali ke Thailand setelah tunangannya melarikan diri membawa seluruh tabungannya. Dalam upaya mencari pelaku, ia mendekati Ploy, seorang aktris ternama yang juga merupakan adik sang buronan. Pencarian tersebut perlahan membuka berbagai rahasia, kebohongan, dan konspirasi yang tidak pernah mereka duga. Di tengah konflik yang semakin rumit, hubungan keduanya berkembang menjadi kisah yang menguji kepercayaan, keberanian, dan arti cinta yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif tentang dinamika politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan budaya di Indonesia dan global. Setiap episode menyajikan berita utama, laporan eksklusif, dan analisis tajam dari para ahli, menggali latar belakang, implikasi, dan berbagai sudut pandang isu relevan. Program ini juga sering menyertakan segmen khusus tentang tren atau kisah inspiratif. Dengan penyampaian yang analitis dan mendalam, tujuannya adalah membekali pemirsa dengan pemahaman utuh dan menjadi referensi penting untuk insight lebih dalam hingga larut malam.

programme.title: Ruang Redaksi
programme.desc: Ruang Redaksi di Sin Po TV adalah program bincang-bincang yang membawa pemirsa ke balik layar proses redaksi berita. Program ini menghadirkan jurnalis, editor, dan pengamat media untuk membahas sudut pandang, tantangan, dan etika pemberitaan. Setiap episode menggali bagaimana isu menjadi penting, verifikasi fakta, dan keputusan editorial diambil, menunjukkan kerja keras serta integritas jurnalistik. Program ini juga sering membahas tren media dan literasi digital. Dengan format santai namun informatif, Ruang Redaksi bertujuan membangun kepercayaan publik pada media dan meningkatkan pemahaman tentang peran vital jurnalisme.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. Dengan perpaduan fantasi, humor, dan aksi yang ringan, serial animasi ini menghadirkan pengalaman yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif bagi anak-anak.

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Love Barista mengisahkan Kang Jun-woo, seorang aktor ternama Korea Selatan yang kariernya mulai meredup. Saat melakukan perjalanan ke Vietnam untuk syuting iklan, sebuah kesalahan membuatnya tertinggal tanpa paspor, uang, maupun manajernya. Dalam kondisi yang serba sulit, ia bertemu Thao, seorang perempuan lokal yang sedang berjuang mewujudkan impiannya menjadi barista profesional. Seiring waktu, keduanya saling membantu dan mulai memahami perbedaan budaya serta latar belakang masing-masing. Hubungan yang awalnya tidak disengaja berkembang menjadi kisah cinta yang manis, sembari mengajarkan arti keberanian, harapan, dan kesempatan kedua dalam hidup.

programme.title: Metro Park S1
programme.desc: Serial web ini bercerita tentang sebuah keluarga Gujarati asal India yang tinggal di Metro Park, Amerika. Payal dan Kalpesh Patel beserta anak-anak mereka mereka adalah keluarga Gujarati yang khas, namun tetap memiliki unsur-unsur kebudayaan India di dalamnya. Serial ini memadukan unsur drama, cinta, dan komedi.

programme.title: Crazy Beggar Suqier

programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Blitz

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: En su camino, Chip y sus amigos encuentran una isla rodeada por un gran lago de ácido, bajo la constante amenaza de erupción de un volcán. En la isla viven átomos de lantánidos que, según la leyenda, esperan la llegada de un «elegido» que les proporcione el ácido que les impide abandonar la isla. Chip, gracias a su libro, descubre que el volcán emitió una base que, al mezclarse con el ácido, puede neutralizar el peligroso lago y convertirlo en una agradable extensión de agua salada.

programme.title: LMN's

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
programme.desc: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Cutthroat Island
programme.desc: Feisty Morgan Adams (Geena Davis) inherits her late buccaneer father's galleon and one-third of a map to buried treasure located on Cutthroat Island. The map had been tattooed on her father's scalp, and to find the treasure, she must locate and scalp his two brothers. But Morgan's swashbuckling uncle, Dawg Brown (Frank Langella), wants the treasure for himself, and does battle with his headstrong niece and her unwilling accomplice, Latin-speaking physician William Shaw (Matthew Modine).

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: After a comet disrupts the rain cycle of Earth, the planet has become a desolate, barren desert by the year 2033. With resources scarce, Kesslee (Malcolm McDowell) -- head of the powerful and evil Water & Power Corporation, the de facto government -- has taken control of the water supply. Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.desc: Ten years have passed since the brutal murder of two teenage girls by a psychopath named Jonah. He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." Meanwhile, six friends on a road trip board the ride, not knowing of the deadly plans Jonah has in store.

programme.title: Last Night

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story

programme.title: Instant Dreams
programme.desc: When Polaroid announced the end of instant film in 2008, many feared the chemical formula would be lost forever. Instant Dreams follows a number of quirky individuals who are connected to Polaroid, who work and create to keep the magic of instant film.

programme.title: Someone Is Watching
programme.desc: Cory is a young boy who has just moved into a new house with his mom. He develops a relationship with an "imaginary" friend who lives in his closet. No one believes him until people start dying violently, and the "imaginary" friend becomes all too real.

programme.title: Chambers Gate
programme.desc: A government official wants to stop crime in his city and make it a safer place for citizens. However, when he is accused of murder it leads to events he never could foresee.

programme.title: Maybe Someday
programme.desc: After separating from her wife, Jay attempts to move across the country but detours to reconnect with a past love and forms an unlikely friendship with a snarky gay comedian as she searches for the courage to move forward with her next chapter in life.

programme.title: Delicious
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, French chef Jacques pursues an obsession to leave his past behind and work for the great British chef Victor Ellwood. He knows Victor had an affair with his mother and may even be his dad.

programme.title: Birdies
programme.desc: The tale of a washed-up golf phenom who gets a job at a country club where catching a buzz is par for the course.

programme.title: Halloween at Aunt Ethel's
programme.desc: Everyone in town knows the story of Old Aunt Ethel. It's said she makes Halloween candy and pumpkin pie out of the kids that trick-or-treat at her house. This Halloween, the neighborhood teens are going to find out the truth.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: T h e m
programme.desc: Humans cannot see them anymore. They control the world and everything that happens in it. Humans live in a comfortable dream that repeats itself. They control the dream. They were humans once too. Now they are something else.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Chavela
programme.desc: The life of pioneering singer Chavela Vargas, from her birth in Costa Rica in 1919 to her death in Mexico in 2012.

programme.title: Game Face
programme.desc: Game Face sheds light on the coming out journeys of LGBTQ athletes. This documentary tells the stories of Fallon Fox, the first female transgender pro MMA fighter, and Terrence Clemens, a college basketball player in Oklahoma, who happens to be gay.

programme.title: Flesh Wounds
programme.desc: On a remote US Army facility, a group of scientists conducting top secret weapon experiments, vanish. An elite covert ops team, commanded by Lt. Tyler, is tasked with recovering the missing personnel within 24 hours.

programme.title: Xanadu Hellfire
programme.desc: A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

programme.title: By Deception
programme.desc: In a macabre, hyperbolic inversion of the famous adage "write what you know," By Deception is a gripping psych thriller about a promising novelist finds himself trapped in a terrifying reality as he reckons with the notion that a murderer is in his midst.

programme.title: Something
programme.desc: A man and woman are struggling to adjust to life with their new baby. But their situation begins to unravel when they suspect a menacing stranger could be lurking, watching... even entering their home.

programme.title: That's Amore
programme.desc: Lucia Lombardi, a single middle aged nurse, finds herself in a difficult situation when she makes a deal with her ailing mother Rosa that involves her unwitting dentist friend Rocco and his best friend Gino.

programme.title: The Exquisite Corpse Project
programme.desc: A first-of-its-kind comedy about five writers who are challenged to each write fifteen minutes of a movie, after having read only the previous five pages of the script.

programme.title: Chambers Gate
programme.desc: A government official wants to stop crime in his city and make it a safer place for citizens. However, when he is accused of murder it leads to events he never could foresee.

programme.title: The Last Seduction
programme.desc: Looking to escape her unhappy marriage, villainous femme fatale Bridget Gregory (Linda Fiorentino) convinces her husband, Clay (Bill Pullman), to sell cocaine, then steals the profits and runs out on him. She stops in a small town en route to Chicago, where she ensnares her next conquest, insurance man Mike Swale (Peter Berg). After getting a job at his insurance company, Bridget convinces Mike to run a scam -- but things take a deadly turn when she recruits him to help get rid of her husband.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: Movie Movie
programme.desc: This spoof of 1930s American films features two movies and a trailer, with the same cast members acting in all three. "Dynamite Hands" follows an up-and-coming boxer (Harry Hamlin) with a heart of gold who stumbles into a life of excess when he falls for a nightclub singer (Trish Van Devere) and meets a sleazy gangster (Eli Wallach). In "Baxter's Beauties of 1933," a Broadway producer (George C. Scott) learns that he is dying and attempts to create one last hit show.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1983
programme.desc: Ten years after the body of a mutilated girl was found in Yorkshire, another young girl is missing. Lawyer John Piggott (Mark Addy) is asked to re-examine the conviction of a disabled man who confessed to the earlier murders and now claims he did so under intense police pressure. As Piggott looks into whether the Yorkshire police tortured their suspect, Detective Jobson (David Morrissey) starts to regret his brutal past and reveals a secret that casts the entire case in a new light.

programme.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
programme.desc: In this silent comedy, college boy William Canfield Jr. (Buster Keaton) reunites with his boat captain father in a Mississippi River town. Though he's flummoxed by Willie's citified appearance, the elder Canfield seems to have found an ally to help him compete with fellow riverboat owner John James King (Tom McGuire). Willie finds himself falling for King's daughter, Mary (Marion Byron), but he has more pressing concerns when the weather turns bad and his father in arrested.

programme.title: Clockwatchers
programme.desc: While she tries to determine her career goals, Iris (Toni Collette) becomes a temporary worker for Global Credit. There, all the regular employees ignore her, so she becomes friendly with three other temps: socializing actress Paula (Lisa Kudrow), conceited Jane (Alanna Ubach) and rebellious Margaret (Parker Posey). Though Margaret pines for a permanent job with the company, a rash of office thefts makes people suspicious of her, and Iris wonders whether to stand behind her new friend.

programme.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
programme.desc: For many years, Heather Mason (Adelaide Clemens) and her father, Harry (Sean Bean), have been on the run from dangerous forces she does not understand. Heather continues to be plagued by terrifying nightmares and frightened by her father's disappearance, and on the eve of her 18th birthday, she discovers that she is not who she thinks she is. The revelation leads her deep into the demonic world of Silent Hill, where she may become trapped forever.

programme.title: Whale Rider
programme.desc: Only males are allowed to ascend to chiefdom in a Maori tribe in New Zealand. This ancient custom is upset when the child selected to be the next chief dies at birth. However, his twin sister, Pai (Keisha Castle-Hughes), survives. At age 12, she enlists the help of her grandmother (Vicky Haughton) and the training of her uncle (Grant Roa) to claim her birthright. But to break with convention, she'll have to do the impossible: win over her ultra-traditional grandfather (Rawiri Paratene).

programme.title: Bullet in the Head
programme.desc: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) land in the 1960s Vietnam.

programme.title: My Best Fiend
programme.desc: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

programme.title: The Wendell Baker Story
programme.desc: Career con artist Wendell Baker (Luke Wilson) discovers he has a talent for straightening out tense situations. Following his release from jail, he decides to pursue a new career in the hospitality industry, and winds up at a retirement home. His new boss (Owen Wilson) is a mean-spirited man who steals the residents' money and treats them like slaves, and tries to involve Wendell in his schemes. Instead, Wendell casts his lot with the residents and helps them fight back.

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: A kung-fu policeman must protect a female witness from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

programme.title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. programme.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programme.desc: Struggling musician Peter Bretter is better-known as the boyfriend of TV star Sarah Marshall. After she unceremoniously dumps him, he feels lost and alone but makes a last-ditch bid to get over it by going to Hawaii. However, she and her new boyfriend are there in the same hotel.

programme.title: The Five-Year Engagement
programme.desc: On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be.

programme.title: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: Weird Science
programme.desc: Teen misfits Gary and Wyatt design their ideal woman on a computer, and a freak electrical accident brings her to life in the form of the lovely, superhuman Lisa. She outfits Gary and Wyatt in cool clothes, surprises them with a Porsche and helps them stand up to jerks Ian and Max. But, all the while, the boys must hide Lisa's existence from Chet, Wyatt's nightmare of a big brother.

programme.title: Problem Child
programme.desc: Ben is a good-hearted guy who's always wanted a son of his own, but so far he and his wife have had no success. The couple adopt Junior, a redheaded hellion who quickly makes their lives miserable. Disaster follows Junior wherever he goes, from camping trips that require emergency-room visits to birthday parties that turn into Grand Guignol affairs. When Ben's incensed family tells him to get rid of the boy, he starts to wonder if they might be right.

programme.title: Problem Child 2
programme.desc: Ben Healy (John Ritter) and his adopted son, the mischievous and destructive Junior (Michael Oliver), move to a new town for a fresh start in what happens to be "the divorcée capital of the world." Now the two face a multitude of women throwing themselves at Ben, though a new mom isn't what Junior wants. But Junior has more to worry about than his father's dates -- the little troublemaker might have met his match in Trixie Young (Ivyann Schwan), a small girl with a big chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: K-9: P.I.
programme.desc: Finally ready to settle into a relaxing retirement, police Detective Mike Dooley and his trusty dog, Jerry Lee, inadvertently find themselves in the middle of a robbery investigation -- as suspects. With his pension now frozen until his name is cleared, Dooley is back on the case with Jerry to find the real criminals. However, since he's a suspect of an FBI investigation and therefore unable to access his old police resources, Dooley has to get creative.

programme.title: K-911
programme.desc: This sequel follows police Detective Michael Dooley and his faithful German shepherd partner, Jerry Lee, who have been working together for 10 years. For Jerry Lee, this means that the canine is quite old, and has a hard time keeping up with police duties. Joining the pair is fellow officer Wendy Welles and her tough Doberman pinscher. Together, Dooley, Welles and their respective dogs attempt to track down a gun-wielding psychopath.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: A devoted dog discovers the meaning of its own existence through the lives of the humans it teaches to laugh and love. Reincarnated as multiple canines over the course of five decades, the lovable pooch develops an unbreakable bond with a kindred spirit named Ethan. As the boy grows older and comes to a crossroad, the dog once again comes back into his life to remind him of his true self.

programme.title: A Dog's Journey
programme.desc: Bailey is living the good life on the Michigan farm of his boy, Ethan and Ethan's wife Hannah. He even has a new playmate: Ethan and Hannah's baby granddaughter, CJ. The problem is that CJ's mom, Gloria, decides to take CJ away. As Bailey's soul prepares to leave this life for a new one, he makes a promise to Ethan to find CJ and protect her at any cost. Thus begins Bailey's adventure through many lives filled with love, friendship, and devotion.

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: Rafi Gardet (Uma Thurman) is a 37-year-old divorced Catholic businesswoman falling for David (Bryan Greenberg), a 23-year-old Jewish artist. With the help of her therapist, Dr. Lisa Metzger (Meryl Streep), Rafi tries to overcome her insecurities and accept the age difference between her and David. But when Lisa learns more about her client's new love, she realizes that David is her son. As Lisa tries to separate the couple, Rafi and David fear that they may not be right for each other after all.

programme.title: My Summer of Love
programme.desc: When upper-class Tamsin (Emily Blunt) meets working-class Mona (Natalie Press) they are immediately drawn to each other. Although coming from different worlds, the two find common ground in their dysfunctional family lives. To seal their friendship, Mona introduces Tamsin to her born-again Christian brother (Paddy Considine), and Mona helps Tamsin spy on her adulterous father. Bound together by their secrets, Tamsin and Mona see their friendship deepen and enter into dangerous waters.

programme.title: For Love of the Game
programme.desc: Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: Loving
programme.desc: Interracial couple Richard and Mildred Loving fell in love and were married in 1958. They grew up in Central Point, a small town in Virginia that was more integrated than surrounding areas in the American South. Yet it was the state of Virginia, where they were making their home and starting a family, that first jailed and then banished them. Richard and Mildred relocated with their children to the inner city of Washington, D.C., but the family ultimately tries to find a way back to Virginia.

programme.title: Kick-Ass
programme.desc: Using his love for comics as inspiration, teenager Dave Lizewski (Aaron Johnson) decides to reinvent himself as a superhero -- despite a complete lack of special powers. Dave dons a costume, dubs himself "Kick-Ass," and gets to work fighting crime. He joins forces with the father/daughter vigilante team of Big Daddy and Hit Girl, then befriends another fledgling crime-fighter called Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse), but a scheming mobster soon puts their alliance to the test.

programme.title: American Ultra
programme.desc: Small-town stoner Mike Howell (Jesse Eisenberg) spends most of his time getting high and writing a graphic novel. What Mike doesn't know is that he was trained by the CIA to be a lethal killing machine. When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Guns Akimbo
programme.desc: Miles is a video game developer who inadvertently becomes the next participant in a real-life death match that streams online. While Miles soon excels at running away from everything, that won't help him outlast Nix, a killer at the top of her game.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Bombshell
programme.desc: The provocative real story of three whip-smart, ambitious, strong women who anchored one of America's most powerful news networks -- becoming headlines themselves when they risked everything to stand up to the man who made them famous.

programme.title: Fair Game
programme.desc: Wife and mother Valerie Plame has a double life as a CIA operative, hiding her vocation from family and friends. Her husband, Joseph Wilson, writes a controversial article in The New York Times, refuting stories about the sale of enriched uranium to Iraq. Then Valerie's secret work and identity is leaked to the press. With her cover blown, and other people endangered, Valerie's career and personal life begin to unravel.

programme.title: Professor Marston & the Wonder Women
programme.desc: If behind every great man is a great woman, then Harvard psychologist and inventor Dr. William Moulton Marston has the good fortune of having two -- his wife Elizabeth and their mutual lover Olive Byrne. In addition to helping him perfect the lie detector test, the two women also inspire him to create one of the greatest female superheroes of all time -- the beloved comic book character Wonder Woman.

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: In 1956 England, Colin Clark (Eddie Redmayne) lands a job as a production assistant on the set of "The Prince and the Showgirl," starring Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams). Marilyn is also honeymooning with her new husband, playwright Arthur Miller, but the combined pressure of work and the demands of the Hollywood hangers-on is driving her to exhaustion. When Miller departs for Paris, Colin seizes the opportunity, to give Marilyn respite during a week in the idyllic British countryside.

programme.desc: Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off! The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!
